content: If the return value of the function Dem_J193 9DcmClearDTC is DEM _PENDING, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall retrigger Dem_ J1939DcmClearDTC (with parameter DTCTypeFilter set to DEM_J1939DTC_CLEAR_ACTIVE_AND_PREVIOUSLY_ACTIVE) in the next call of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.

If the return value of the function Dem_J193 9DcmClearDTC is DEM _PENDING, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall retrigger Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC (with parameter DT CTypeFilter set to DEM_J1939DTC_CLEAR_ACTIVE_AND_PREVIOUSLY_ACTIVE) in the next call of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.

If the return value of the function Dem_J193 9DcmClearDTC is DEM _PENDING, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall retrigger Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC (with parameter DT CTypeFilter set to DEM_J1939DTC_CLEAR_ACTIVE_AND_PREVIOUSLY_ACTIVE) in the next call of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.
